This week, [democracy won](https://zeteo.com/p/blue-tsunami-watch-zeteos-
coverage). Americans showed that even when a president and his cronies attempt
to steal an election, in a democracy - even one under relentless attacks - the
people have the power of the polls.

Now, the real work begins, as Democrats must do something with the power
they've been given - and seek to hold Donald Trump and his allies accountable
for all they've done.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

That won't be easy. Even a lame duck Trump will continue harming democracy,
undermining the Constitution, and harming societies worldwide. Just three days
after American voters sent a clear message that they were not happy with
Trump's policies, he [named](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-trump-names-stephen-
miller) Stephen Miller - the very architect of those outrageous policies - as
his new White House chief of staff.

It's a sign of what's to come, and **Zeteo** will continue to document the
growing authoritarianism in Trump's America, as we've done below. From a
possible pre-emptive pardon for Elon Musk to the DOJ's move to vacate Steve
Bannon's contempt of Congress conviction, here's 'This Week in Democracy -
Week 94':

#### **Saturday, Oct. 31 - DHS Chief Says Agency Investigating Potential
Noncitizens**

On Fox, Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin
[said](https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/dhs-secretary-mullin-
claims-300000-noncitizens-under-investigation-for-illegally-voting/) the
department has 1,600 active investigations into potential noncitizens voting
in U.S. elections, and claimed without evidence that the agency found 300,000
noncitizens on state voter rolls, even though noncitizen voting has already
proven [exceedingly
rare](https://www.npr.org/2025/07/30/nx-s1-5462836/noncitizen-voting-trump-
ceir-review).

Trump's Justice Department already
[failed](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/02/nx-s1-6023802/supreme-court-
california-voting-ballots-trump) to block the votes of more than 20,000 people
accused of being potential noncitizens. An
[analysis](https://s3.documentcloud.org/documents/28861415/chirla-filing.pdf)
of the DOJ list found that more than 40% of the individuals didn't even appear
in the state's voter rolls.

#### **Sunday, Nov. 1 - Trump Admin May Have Violated Hatch Act**

The _New York Times_
[reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/01/us/elections/social-security-
email-trump-hatch-act.html) that several legal experts have suggested the
Trump administration may have violated the Hatch Act, passed in 1939 to limit
certain political activities of federal employees.

The violations stem from mass emails sent by the Social Security
Administration and the IRS last week praising Trump ahead of Election Day, a
move one expert said seemed designed to serve as "propaganda" rather than a
public service announcement.

#### **Monday, Nov. 2 - Trump Says He Will Pre-Emptively Pardon Musk and
Others**

In an interview with the _New York Post_ , Trump
[said](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/02/us/politics/trump-pardons-democrats-
congress-control.html) he would offer a pre-emptive pardon to former adviser
Elon Musk if Democrats took control of Congress and began investigating the
world's richest man or his business practices.

His pre-emptive pardons would also extend to aides and allies who could be at
risk of probes and prosecutions by Democratic lawmakers, saying, "We just have
to protect those people."

#### **Tuesday, Nov. 3 - No Shortage of Historic Victories in Midterm
Elections**

A blue tsunami swept across the country, as voters
[issued](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-dems-take-full-control-of-congress) a
damning rebuke of the Trump administration and gave Democrats control of both
the House and the Senate come 2027.

Election night featured a series of historic firsts, including, among others:

  * Abdul El-Sayed becoming the first Muslim U.S. senator

  * A record number of women being [elected](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/record-number-female-governors-elected-rcna607366) as governors, with [Keisha Lance Bottoms](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/03/us/georgia-governor-bottoms-jackson.html) and [Deb Haaland](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/new-mexicos-deb-haaland-on-making-history-as-first-native-american-woman-elected-governor) becoming the first Black and Native American women, respectively, to win a gubernatorial election.

  * [Peggy Flanagan](https://minnesotareformer.com/2026/11/03/peggy-flanagan-wins-minnesota-us-senate-seat-in-first-for-native-american-women/) becoming the first Native American woman elected senator

  * [Chris Pappas](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/03/new-hampshire-senate-chris-pappas-john-sununu) becoming the first openly gay man in the U.S. Senate.

Read more about the historic victories

#### **Wednesday, Nov. 4 - Hegseth Facing Impeachment…or Replacement**

Outgoing Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Ky.)
[told](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/04/politics/pete-hegseth-impeachment-
trump?cid=ios_app) CNN he plans to trigger a vote to impeach Defense Secretary
Pete Hegseth when Congress reconvenes next week, a move that multiple GOP
sources told the cable network is expected to pass.

But Hegseth may not remain in his role long enough to be impeached, as NBC
News [reported](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/national-security/trump-
discussing-possible-hegseth-replacements-sources-say-rcna607503) that Trump is
already looking for a possible replacement for the former Fox personality.

#### **Thursday, Nov. 5 - Trump's DOJ Tries to Toss Bannon Conviction…Again**

Trump's Justice Department once again
[moved](https://storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.dcd.237438/gov.uscourts.dcd.237438.213.0.pdf)
to vacate former White House chief strategist Steve Bannon's [2022
conviction](https://www.justice.gov/usao-dc/pr/stephen-k-bannon-sentenced-
four-months-prison-two-counts-contempt-congress) on two counts of contempt of
Congress after he failed to comply with a subpoena to appear before the
House's Jan. 6 panel.

The court filing noted that the administration "harbors significant doubts"
about the fairness of his trial, and that seeking to affirm Bannon's
conviction "is inconsistent with this Administration's enforcement
priorities."

#### **Friday, Nov. 6 - Trump Taps Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff**

Trump
[announced](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/117571000109141399)
he was replacing Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller as his White House chief of
staff.

Already seen as Trump's top domestic policy adviser, Miller has been the
[architect](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-trump-names-stephen-miller) of some
of Trump's most outrageous policies, including his racist and violent war on
immigrants.

Speaking about the Republicans' catastrophic losses at the polls this week, a
GOP operative [told](https://zeteo.com/p/republicans-groan-trump-and-stephen)
**Zeteo 's** **Asawin Suebsaeng** and**Andrew Perez** that Miller "screwed us
big time."
